title: Investigation grade caps highlights at .775: saturated glow turns pastel
summary: Investigation caps highlights at .775: red clips first, so hot orange goes salmon/peach and whites read milky. Set settings.post.cap .95-.97 in project.json.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Any scene with saturated emissive colours (glowing people, fire, neon) or any shot match.
doc.avoid: Raising the emissive to fight the cap (it gets paler, not hotter).
gotchas: The grade is project-wide: a scene cannot override it, so the cap belongs to the shot's recipe.
Keep the emissive moderate (~.9) and the fresnel low and red-orange.

problem.symptom: Glowing figures look pastel, salmon or peach instead of saturated orange; whites look milky.
problem.cause: THEME.grade.cap .775 in the Investigation look clips the red channel first.
problem.detect: Region means: the glow's G/R ratio rises toward .7 (reference ~.46).
